jungle.Xyris: Rewards farming; each kill adds damage, so keep camps cleared. Bone Collector later gives crit chance that Minueta's stabs can partly use.
jungle.Weald: Hitting a low hero fires missiles that pass through walls for bonus true damage. First Intent's dash triggers Wind-Rider's attack speed for the follow-up.

midlane.Aion: Rewards constant casting: spells build mana regeneration and earn gold from hero damage, so poke with Hive and Mark often. Arcane Resonance turns that regeneration into faster cooldowns.
midlane.Lotus: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Immaculate cuts damage while you're healthy, so poke safely with Hive instead of trading at low health.
midlane.Vesh: Mark, Hive, Swarm and Curse each leave a burn on top of Pestilence, so poke and let both tick. Lich adds healing beyond what Mark already drains.

offlane.Aion: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns, and Mark, Hive and Swarm hits on heroes earn gold. Keep steady pressure on your lane opponent.
offlane.Vesh: Each ability hit adds lingering damage on top of Pestilence's own ticking damage. Lich heals you from magic damage, so Swarm through enemies and keep trading.

support.Lotus: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Flawless heals you and nearby allies when Contagion or Beguile hits a hero, so open fights with them.
support.Knell: Your hits strip enemy armor and give you part of it, alongside Contagion's armor cut. With Peal, attacks right after Eclipse apply full stacks, so go in immediately.
support.Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, stacking with Contagion's armor, helps you stand in front. Dropping low triggers a shield that buys time to Beguile or back off.

offlane.Krix: More health makes you a sturdier front line, and Extract's heal grows with it since it restores a share of max health. Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns.

jungle.Weald: Hitting a low-health hero fires a few small true-damage missiles that fly through walls at them. Forage adds gold and XP; Taproot heals you every swing.
jungle.Vermis: Rewards steady three-hit chains on one hero, matching Windburn's own third-hit bonus. Stick to your target with Lash Kick; Serration hits harder as their health drops.

offlane.Weald: When a hero drops low, your hits fire a few small true-damage missiles that pass through walls. Taproot heals each swing; Forage speeds farming.

support.Lotus: Takedowns and time add random bonuses, so stay in fights beside your linked ally. Flawless heals you and nearby allies whenever Psychic Flare or Energy Lance hits a hero.
support.Exarch: Each heal or shield you give boosts that ally's attack speed and adds magic damage to their basic attacks, so link your carry and keep them topped up.
support.Aion: Casting builds mana and pays some gold off hero damage, helping you afford items as support. Perfection gives extra ability haste while you're healthy, so stay out of enemy poke.

jungle.Krix: Behemoth heals by a share of max health, so extra health means bigger heals and a sturdier body under Tiny Titan. Predator rewards ganking right after Camp Leader kills.

support.Aion: Each cast stacks mana regeneration and hero damage pays extra gold, so poke with Maco Sparkle! and Maco Gift! often; Arcane Resonance then brings basic abilities back faster.
support.Exarch: Maco Gift! heals and Maco Fly! shields, and both arm the target with faster, harder-hitting attacks. Gift your carry before they fight; Revelation brings abilities back sooner.
support.Pilow: Every cast weakens nearby enemy heroes, so stay close and keep throwing Maco Fly! and Maco Sparkle!. Convection hands you armor for each stack you keep up.

jungle.Weald: Once a hero drops under 30%, a few small missiles fly through walls at them. Pole Vault plus Wind-Rider stacks attack speed, adding missiles; Forage adds gold and XP.
jungle.Demiurge: Every item you buy gives a bit more stats. Construct adds health and ability haste every level, helping you cast more often.
jungle.Thraex: Stick to one target with basic attacks to keep the mark on them. Ferocity stacks attack speed in long fights; Alpha's Court adds damage when no ally is near.

midlane.Aion: Every cast stacks mana regen, easing Exsanguinate's rising mana cost, and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Sacrifice restores mana on hero hits; Runic Focus favors high mana.
midlane.Vesh: Arterial Grip, Rupture blades and bats all leave lingering damage on heroes. Lich turns that magic damage into healing, pairing with Exsanguinate's own sustain.

jungle.Lotus: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Guillotine wounded targets to secure kills; Prima Donna boosts hero damage but makes you squishier, so strike first.
jungle.Demiurge: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. Tri-Core adds damage to every hit, and Bloatware toughens you for each item you own.
jungle.Satariel: Each takedown makes you hit harder but lowers your health, and dying wipes it. Use Shadow Walk to catch isolated targets; Demonic Bargain's gold speeds your start.

offlane.Nihil: Doom grows while you keep hitting heroes, so trade often and use Siphon and Subjugate to stay in contact. Adaptive Plating adds armor as you take hits.
offlane.Krix: Extra health stacks with Reaper of Souls and Siphon's stolen health, turning you into a huge front line. Cannibalism adds permanent health on every takedown.

jungle.Krix: Stacks with the bonus health from Reaper of Souls, making Sevarog a huge frontline. Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns, and Regenerative Tissue heals you between fights.

jungle.Lotus: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Chain Severance resets to secure kills, and Masterpiece's speed after kills reaches the next target.
jungle.Demiurge: Items give more stats and their effects hit harder. Construct adds health and ability haste each level, so you cast more often and trigger Hallowed Strikes more.
jungle.Vesh: Anima Burst, Severance and Soulstorm keep burning after they hit a hero. Mind Rot hits healthy targets hardest, so open with your abilities before they drop.

midlane.Vesh: Missiles, mines and Make It Rain each leave a burn, so poke from range. The Tenth Seal makes Make It Rain stronger and faster to return.
midlane.Demiurge: Every item you buy gives a bit more stats. Memory Leak grows your max mana as you cast, and Armed Salvo restores mana when it hits heroes.
midlane.Aion: Pays gold whenever your spells hit heroes, and each cast feeds mana regeneration, so keep casting. Runic Focus adds magical power while mana is high, which Armed Salvo helps refill.
